texts.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

A shifting mass of thoughts settles around our minds. Abrasive weight flows over us, warping our perception of time. Each grain of thought chafes and grinds against the texture of this newfound domain.

As the sensation subsides, the Fathomless Being sloughs away and leaves lasting impressions behind.

These tracks linger before us, inviting us to follow.

texts.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为无底之物。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Fathomless Being.

texts.zh:
无底之物从虚境中破土而出。祂的存在无形而宽广，无边无际地在我们的视野中蔓延。

一种有颗粒感的低语从我们身上倾泻而下，冲开了埋藏已久的历史。我们看到被遗忘的帝国在不可阻挡的时间之流中化为灰烬。每一颗冲刷过我们的沙粒都是一段记忆。

在这片浩瀚的档案中，模式出现了——那是野心和毁灭、胜利和衰败的循环。智慧便潜藏于此。

无尽之潮汐伸展超过了时间维度，打磨掉无知，只留下愿意忍受之物。
texts.en:
The Fathomless Being has been unearthed from the Shroud. Formless yet vast, its presence stretches endlessly across the range of our perception.

A textured whisper cascades through us, unravelling long-buried histories. We see forgotten empires ground to dust by the unstoppable march of time. Each grain that washes over us is a memory.

Within this boundless archive, patterns emerge - cycles of ambition and ruin, triumph and decay. There is wisdom within these depths.

The Endless Tide stretches beyond time, wearing away ignorance and leaving only what has the will to endure.

# 无尽之潮汐 / Endless Tide

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt` · `events/shroud_events.txt` · `common/inline_scripts/shroud/minor_patron_first_contact_end_event.txt` · `common/patrons/patron_types.txt`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 次要赞助者“无尽之潮汐”的首次接触事件“虚境中的低语”（shroud.4070），由代码在虚境中自然发现时触发（common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1429），或经“虚境触及者”选项触发（须已接触全部主要赞助者）。  
  First-contact event "Whispers in the Shroud" (shroud.4070) of the minor patron "Endless Tide", launched by the game on natural discovery in the Shroud (common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1429) or by the Shroud-touched option (all major patrons must be contacted first).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- shroud.4070：单一选项“尝试沟通”按帝国类型启用机械版/蜂巢版/基础版接触项目（events/shroud_events.txt:8772，inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start_event）。  
  shroud.4070: the single option enables the robot / hive / base contact project by empire type (events/shroud_events.txt:8772, inline script minor_patron_first_contact_start_event).
- 项目成本5000（社会科技），无时限，完成后触发shroud.4075。  
  The project costs 5000 (society technology), has no time limit and fires shroud.4075 on completion.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- shroud.4075仅一个选项，把接触状态记为completed。  
  shroud.4075 has a single option that sets the first-contact state to completed.
- 三个项目版本互斥，仅由帝国类型决定。  
  The three project versions are mutually exclusive and depend only on empire type.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无其他差异。  
  No other variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt、events/shroud_events.txt与inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event。  
  Compared %s, %s and the minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event inline scripts.
- 合并：原有的_HIVE与_ROBOT故事是同一接触项目的帝国类型版本，现并入本故事。  
  Merged: the former _HIVE and _ROBOT stories are the empire-type versions of the same contact project and are now part of this one story.
- 以起始事件为根并添加审阅连接。 项目标题使用游戏内的“未接触前代号”（如“Fathomless Being”），本故事标题使用赞助者名称。  
  The start event is the root, with reviewed bridges. Project titles use the in-game pre-contact code names (e.g. Fathomless Being); the story title uses the patron name.
